TASK.note: Exosuit/mech/Rigidbody/joint archaeology performed; no dedicated joint-driven exosuit rig found, existing player controller bridge hijacked.

Exosuit grapple/jump/gravity plus generic player motor mutation paths are gated when the DataVault kinematic authority is bound: environment force buffers are consumed without motor writes, queued external velocity is skipped, KCC sweep/wall-scrape feedback is suppressed, wipeout/damping/clamp mutators are skipped, and exosuit foot ray probes are disabled.
Hot state flattened to raw unmanaged fields; no DTO properties in SHINOBU_276 exosuit payloads.
ExosuitLayoutVerifier validates sizes and editor offsets for state, input, tuning, signals, screen, terrain, output, telemetry.
GenerateMockExosuitInputsJob remains deterministic Burst fuzzer/fallback; production runtime collapses procedural drift into the single integration job to avoid a tiny scheduled job.
ExosuitKinematicIntegrationJob integrates velocity/AUP with deterministic Burst, NoAlias lanes, thrust, gravity, drag, heat, and SDF response.

Integrated SDF depenetration now consumes owner-published byte voxel SDF payloads through a 64-byte Core.Contracts VoxelSdfPayloadDescriptorDTO plus locked BufferID.VoxelSdfTexture3D Vault alias; analytic MockTerrainSDF remains emergency fallback only.
Hydraulic pressure, lateral/contact damping, angular damping, and seabed/contact drag are pure math, not PhysX joints.
Magnetic clamp intent maps to unmanaged action bit; solver clamps on SDF contact by zeroing velocities and holding the contact normal.
SDF substeps use int(lerp(2, MaxSubsteps, GlobalQualityWeight)) with MaxSubsteps editor/CSV tuning, no hardware-tier switch.
All collision-local positions subtract double3 camera/sector AUP before casting to float3.
Heat, cooldown, overheat, and thruster gating are implemented. SOA inventory battery drain is dependency-blocked until an unmanaged battery-cell route is exposed.
Authority state is blittable 64-byte explicit DTO; Burst jobs use FloatMode.Deterministic and fixed dt input.
Vault lanes use NativeArrayOptions.UninitializedMemory and are explicitly seeded during cold boot.

300-entry telemetry ring writes AUP/velocity/heat/pressure/push/time/hash; dumps Dump_SHINOBU_276.bin on NaN/fault and on over-0.1ms completions after marking BudgetExceeded, with one dump per frame guard.
UI Toolkit tuner writes mass, SDF epsilon, gravity multiplier, max substeps, and quality into ExosuitTuningDTO through the runtime writer-lock facade.

CSV parser ingests once during cold Vault initialization and editor-only reload; it loads into Vault scratch through Span<byte> while holding the scratch writer fence, parses ReadOnlySpan<byte> slices, commits tuning only while holding the tuning writer fence, and avoids string.Split, managed byte arrays, and player fixed-tick file IO.
OnDrawGizmos/SceneView tools render capsule bounds and SDF normals from Vault readback.

Exosuit_Physics_Inquisition scanner exists and emits pass/fail verdicts; guarded legacy ApplyExosuit* Rigidbody paths are warnings, unguarded Rigidbody/joint hits fail the report. Dedicated CLI JSON exists; shared aggregate node remains pending Unity editor scanner execution.
This audit, architecture doc, rationale, status, and log are disk proof artifacts; Unity compile/profiler proof remains gated.

DTO.name: ExosuitStateDTO
DTO.MATH: 24 + 12 + 12 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 64 bytes; no Pack=1; one ARM64 L1 cache line.

DTO.name: ExosuitTelemetryEntry
DTO.note: 300-row black box ring; AUP@0, Velocity@24, heat/pressure/push/time@36..48, frame/flags/hash@52..60.

SCALABILITY_CURVE.LOW: SDF radius skin widens to 1.5x epsilon, collision work trends to 2 substeps, voxel SDF collapses to nearest-neighbor distance with cheap radial normal fallback and no trilinear taps while smoothstep weight is zero, CCD contribution is near zero until smoothstep rises, signal lanes use minimum quality frame caps, hydraulic response is heavier.
SCALABILITY_CURVE.MIDDLE: Substeps lerp toward 4-6, voxel SDF blends from nearest toward trilinear, secondary probes blend in by smoothstep, current/drag and actuator latency remain continuous.
SCALABILITY_CURVE.HIGH_ULTRA: Solver reaches MaxSubsteps, tight SDF epsilon 0.55x, trilinear voxel SDF plus finite-difference normal blend, stronger CCD/secondary contact smoothing; extra budget feeds haptic/silt/acoustic presentation, not new gameplay truth fields.

H_PHI_VAULT_STATUS.OWNER_NOTE: All SHINOBU_276 generation handles use SystemID.Physics. Hecton8.Core.ExosuitKinematicAuthority stores only a pending DTO, owns no Vault memory, rejects bind/authority/unbind unless the input handle owner is SystemID.Physics, and clears pending intent on invalid bind.

READ_FENCE.note: TryLockBuffer and TryUnlockBuffer both resolve flat metadata; TryAcquireWriteLock rejects active reader counts before exposing mutable arrays; completed exosuit jobs release external SDF read locks before black-box file IO; SHINOBU runtime buffer views and TryReadTuning use pure TryReadHandle rather than mutating TryResolveHandle; Core facade bind/authority/unbind, public read facades, and local SHINOBU handles reject non-Physics owner handles; invalid Core binds clear pending intent; TryWriteTuning, CSV ingestion, cold seed writes, and frame-input staging mutations validate Physics-owned handles before TryAcquireWriteLock/ReleaseWriteLock with SystemID.Physics. Scheduled mutable job lanes are writer-locked; read-only terrain/flow/crush lanes are read-locked. Telemetry elapsed patch writes under the still-held completed telemetry/cursor writer job locks.

JOB_WRITER_LOCK_FENCE.note: TryAcquireJobBufferViews replaces TryLockJobBuffers/BindJobBufferViews. State/Input/Tuning/Output/Screen/Telemetry/Cursor/Footstep/Haptic/Silt/Acoustic lanes use TryAcquireJobWriteBuffer and pass the writer-lock arrays directly to the Burst integration job; Terrain/Flow/Crush use TryAcquireJobReadBuffer.

TUNING_WRITE_FENCE.note: Editor-facing tuning mutation writes sanitized ExosuitTuningDTO[0] only while holding the ShinobuExosuitTuning writer lock and releases it in finally. Cold/editor CSV ingestion writes the scratch lane only while holding ShinobuExosuitCsvScratch writer lock, then commits parsed tuning only while holding ShinobuExosuitTuning writer lock.

OWNER_PHASE_WRITE_FENCE.note: GenerateEmergencyMockExoData seeds all touched SHINOBU rows through TryAcquireWriteBuffer/ReleaseWriteBuffer. WriteFrameInputs stages tuning/input/terrain/flow/crush rows through the same wrappers before scheduling the Burst job.
